messages:
devon.smith: :rotating_light: Seeing a spike of 5xxs for Zephyr Enterprise (dedicated eu-west-1). Error rate ~23% over baseline, started ~09:02 UTC. Pager firing.

sre-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-4891 — Zephyr dedicated pool routing errors. Severity: P1. On-call: devon.smith, casey.lee.

casey.lee: I'm taking the live handoff at 09:06 UTC. pulling pods, checking autoscaler and config sync. devon, paste the relevant logs or query you ran.

devon.smith: brief log snippet: `grpc: failed to forward request to backend: 503 resource exhausted` repeated across multiple hosts. Found autoscaler policy hit a threshold and some nodes became unschedulable after recent kernel patch.

maria.gomez: Notifying Zephyr AMs now. Sending tailored customer note — they requested explicit impact + next steps. Primary Zephyr contacts: Kate Davis (kate@zephyr.com), ops@zephyr.com. CC: account-team.

casey.lee: Draft status page copy (internal preview):
```
Status: Partial degradation — Dedicated eu-west-1 (Zephyr Enterprise)
Start time: 2026-09-04 09:02 UTC
Impact: Some API requests for Zephyr Enterprise are returning 5xx errors or timing out. Affected tenants: zephyr-corp-prod (dedicated pool).
Action: Engineers are applying a rollback to the autoscaler push and draining impacted nodes. Mitigation ETA: ~15–25 minutes; updates every 10 minutes.
```

casey.lee: Draft customer-facing email (tailored):
```
Subject: Incident affecting Zephyr Enterprise dedicated capacity — 09:02 UTC
Hi Kate,
We’re investigating an issue impacting requests served from your dedicated eu-west-1 pool. Some requests may receive 5xx errors or experience elevated latency. Our engineers have identified a misconfiguration in the autoscaling rollout and are rolling back the change and bringing additional capacity online. We expect service to be restored within ~30 minutes. We’ll follow up with a full incident summary and any customer impact metrics.
Sincerely,\nRedwood Inference Ops
```

maria.gomez: Sending that now. tagging account team for any contract-specific notices. @casey.lee please include any extra SLA phrasing if needed.

casey.lee: Good call. For Zephyr enterprise SLA: note possible request retries and offer a 1-day usage credit if their SLO baseline was breached. I'll add to the outbound.

opsbot: 🟡 Autoscaler rollback started by casey.lee — rolling upgrade ID: roll-4891-rollback. Progress: 3/8 nodes updated.

devon.smith: Applying a manual drain on two stuck nodes and forcing scheduler resync. Temporary routing fallback enabled to cold-standby pool for Zephyr traffic to reduce errors.

statusbot: Public status page updated (internal preview) — now showing partial degradation. Next update scheduled in 10 minutes.

casey.lee: Handoff notes for escalation — if rollback does not reduce error rate in 20m escalate to infra-leads and open dedicated-capacity surge. Key commands I used: `kubectl cordon <node>`, `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets`, and `redwood-infra autoscaler rollback --id roll-4891`.

devon.smith: Error rate down to 8% now, 09:22 UTC. Rolling to full mitigation. Keeping an eye on KV cache warmups.

maria.gomez: Zephyr replied — thanks for the quick notice; want a summary once fully resolved. They asked for a list of affected request windows.

casey.lee: Confirmed mitigation at 09:29 UTC — error rate back to baseline. Posting final status update + sending tailored email with exact window (09:02–09:29 UTC) and affected endpoints. Will kick off postmortem template.

sre-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: INC-4891 — Zephyr dedicated pool routing errors. Duration: 27 minutes. Postmortem assigned to: devon.smith, casey.lee.

casey.lee: Quick internal comms template for CS/AM: "We experienced a dedicated-pool routing incident affecting Zephyr from 09:02–09:29 UTC. Root cause: autoscaler rollout misconfiguration after kernel update causing node unschedulable states. Impact: 5xxs + elevated latency for zephyr-corp-prod. Remediation: rollback applied, nodes drained and replaced, temporary routing to cold-standby. Follow-up: postmortem with timeline and remediation plan in 48 hours." :thumbsup:

maria.gomez: I'll send to Kate + AM thread and attach timestamped logs. Good work team. :tada:
